ideas.pitch: A mobile-first web app that translates and explains classical Kannada literary inscriptions in real-time using computer vision and multimodal LLMs.

ideas.title: NudiLens AI

ideas.pitch: An interactive audio-first tourism planner for lesser-known heritage sites in Karnataka, featuring localized Kannada voice narration and offline-friendly route maps.

ideas.title: Janapada Sanchari

ideas.pitch: A gamified, interactive learning portal built specifically for children and non-native speakers to master conversational Kannada through speech-to-text pronunciation scoring.
